name: mobile-use-codex
description: Control mobile devices with bundled mobile-mcp tools and watch them in a Codex MCP Apps panel.

interface.shortDescription: 操作移动设备，并实时查看设备画面
interface.longDescription: Control connected iOS and Android devices with bundled mobile-mcp tools. Launch apps, tap, swipe and type while viewing live device screens in the Codex side panel. Capture is shared per device and stops when device work ends.
defaultPrompt: Show my connected devices and open a live monitor.
在 iPad 拼多多搜索 iqoo 手机，同时显示实时画面。
